scope: User selected Apple-spraak voorbereiden; reconcile incoming Core recovery-notice UX handoff in existing sole writer.
producer_gate: Core66ee0cc1 was superseded by added recovery-notice scope. Require new exact reviewed producer pin, schema, safe machinecodes, voice-options/prepare/audio fixtures and qualified delivery before contract implementation. Do not reuse old exact review/publication grant.
current_consumer_findings: DJConnectSpeechTransport accepts PCM WAV only; MP3 requires MIME and actual bounded binary validation, not MIME-only relaxation.
No prepareSpeech/speechAudio calls found in DJConnectUI. New private speech must be integrated with reference-bound output ownership.
Legacy replayAskDJAudio uses AVPlayer URL; do not feed new paired private POST assets through legacy public URL playback.
speakDemoResponse is explicitly Demo speech and cannot become silent fallback for configured HA provider failure.

presentation.placement: Inline within DJ-sessie near affected contribution/listen control; retain contribution text and other session controls. No global blocking alert.
presentation.mapping: Functional categories are planning labels, not invented wire machinecodes. Bind to exact future versioned producer codes; preserve existing expiry/access-denial distinctions.
presentation.help_action: Open an accessible in-app instruction panel naming selected HA Assist pipeline and TTS provider connection/access/language/voice checks. Do not mutate HA or invent an unverified deep link.
presentation.retry_action: Explicit user tap only, same accepted speechreference, current authority/expiry/provider revision and server backoff; never replay original AskDJ execute or playback action.
presentation.runtime_status: Pairing-time capability is not current provider health. A failed voice-options refresh does not establish availability. Unknown version/code gives safe generic notice and no silent retry.
accessibility: Native accessible text and buttons, semantic grouping and Dynamic Type
Announce newly changed functional failure once; no repeating polling announcements or focus stealing
Retry disabled during in-flight request/backoff; error/help must remain reachable
Long German/French copy at accessibility sizes and narrow layout must remain scrollable

nl.title: Spraak is niet beschikbaar
nl.body: Je kunt de bijdrage blijven lezen. Controleer in Home Assistant de Assist-pipeline die in DJConnect is gekozen: de TTS-provider, de verbinding en toegang van die provider, de taal en de stem.
nl.retry_later: Wacht even voordat je opnieuw luistert.

en.title: Speech is unavailable
en.body: You can still read the contribution. In Home Assistant, check the Assist pipeline selected in DJConnect: its TTS provider, the provider connection and access, the language and the voice.
en.retry_later: Wait a moment before listening again.

de.title: Sprachausgabe ist nicht verfügbar
de.body: Du kannst den Beitrag weiterhin lesen. Prüfe in Home Assistant die in DJConnect ausgewählte Assist-Pipeline: den TTS-Anbieter, dessen Verbindung und Zugriffsrechte sowie die Sprache und Stimme.
de.retry_later: Warte einen Moment, bevor du den Beitrag erneut anhörst.

fr.title: La lecture vocale est indisponible
fr.body: Vous pouvez toujours lire la contribution. Dans Home Assistant, vérifiez le pipeline Assist sélectionné dans DJConnect : son fournisseur TTS, la connexion et les autorisations du fournisseur, la langue et la voix.
fr.retry_later: Patientez un instant avant de réécouter.

es.title: La reproducción de voz no está disponible
es.body: Puedes seguir leyendo la contribución. En Home Assistant, revisa el pipeline de Assist seleccionado en DJConnect: su proveedor TTS, la conexión y el acceso del proveedor, el idioma y la voz.
es.retry_later: Espera un momento antes de volver a escuchar.

implementation_sequence: Import exact producer fixtures and map versioned status/notice codes with no raw provider errors or secret logging
Bound typed WAV/MP3 response validation and memory-only audio output, preserving redirect/size/time/privacy guards
Integrate one reference-bound Session speech owner; recheck ticket/authority after every suspension and before output
Render scoped inline recovery notice and accessible help/retry in five languages
Run focused contract/authority/format tests; then selective signed candidate and actual iPad qualification only after complete implementation
acceptance_matrix: Missing/invalid/unavailable TTS: text and session controls retained; helpful localized notice
voice-options availability changes after pairing and after foreground/reconnect
provider change during prepare and private audio download rejects stale output
HTTP auth/expiry/session end/stop/Profile change cancel pending output and prohibit retry without authority
WAV and MP3 real valid bytes accepted; MIME mismatch/truncated/oversize/corrupt/redirect rejected
backoff prevents duplicate preparation; explicit retry retains original reference; no original execute replay
five language long-copy and VoiceOver/DynamicType qualification
actual installed private-audio playback and interruption tests remain separate from source/model tests
effects: Preparation document only. No product code, app install, audio/provider request, HA configuration, publication or new permission request.
validation: Five language key sets and required acceptance cases checked locally; no runtime/audio PASS claimed.
